title: Missed Weekend Dispatch Rates for Mobile In-Home Collection Visits
content:
## Rate card — Specimen Collection Appointments

A missed home visit's no-show charge starts from a rate set by the day of the week of the missed appointment date (the appointment date on the visit record, which a no-show leaves unchanged):

| Missed appointment date | Starting rate (USD) |
|---|---|
| Sunday | 80.00 |
| Saturday | 75.00 |
| Monday to Friday | 60.00 (the published no-show fee) |

**Clause.** A missed visit whose appointment date is a Sunday starts from 80.00, one whose appointment date is a Saturday starts from 75.00, and a missed weekday visit starts from the published no-show fee of 60.00. The published no-show fee is 60.00 for the Mobile In-Home Collection Visit and 0.00 for every other visit type.

**Readings (hypothetical).** A Mobile In-Home Collection Visit missed on a Saturday: 75.00. Missed on a Sunday: 80.00. Missed on a Friday: 60.00.
